about: Package 2 (containers and read-outs): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 33-containers.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html: all pass there). `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios that exercise these containers and read-outs and still cannot run, each with what it waits for or why it cannot pass as written.

scenarios.why: terminal, termLine, termBar: each control after its flag, a command line that hangs, the Lab lines under the rule (.tparams), a terminal chip that brings its token, a flag, Studio without the Lab lines.
terminal: with its power switch off the lines stand back at 45% and stay editable, the switch does not; planText says the planner is off.
planText in its four looks: the planner's pick or yours (a key spelled as a musician does), the lyrics' sections, YuE2's score, MiniMax-Music3's prose, HeartMuLa's tags and length.

terminal and termLine standing back: a guard at 1.00 says so on its line, the planner off says so in its place (L-11), YuE2's line-and-strip pairs (.gline) each off on its own; a node's when on a token.

lcdRow: the top row lends the number its beat lamps (beatPulse: a lamp a beat, resting on auto, the beat's length) and its buttons; the key row's word; the trim settings held out of sight while Auto-trim is off.

group, pair, adhereCurve: a power chip in the header, hatched while off, tokens in pairs with the range's arrow, the curve's band and legend; a group switched by a pill (.lat-g) and its compact choice.

deck and labelled in a deck: two columns, the recorders' lines indented, the changed mark after the row's label (E-36), a recorder standing back and the replay that is not used said (E-34); the planner's bar says the cache (E-15).
dice (a die per try, off with re-planning), flowWindows (the windows and the count follow the hop, the joins), speedGauge (the trade's speed).
lrcPreview (the first section of the lyrics), unitBadge, coverSwatch, unitStatus with its tip.

dropZone: a chosen file on a pedal's slot is a step named for it, × clears it, a file that is no audio is refused and said, a dropped file on a sleeve loads, a drop outside every zone says where to drop, a file another module lends is shown as lent.
bank: its heading and tip, the 2-1-0 scale, a fader a group on its tape, a fader in the bank works.
dropZone: a file dropped on the Mastering pedal's slot is its own step, named for the file, and Ctrl+Z takes it out alone (L-01).
termLine: the composer's CFG token on its line reads auto one way, after a step and a reset (E-13).

waiting.because: After package 8 merged, its last check fails: the token's tip is not the setting's explanation. Package 8's tips are being fixed for it.

scenarios.why: termLine with a terminal text field (--seed): what was typed is kept and what is in force is said (E-33).
lcdRow: Tempo's Beat I/O switch stands in its LCD row on Stable Audio 3 and draws its markers (B-04).
bank and deck: the Plan fader of the master section below 1.00 brings Compact planner cache into the Last plan row at once, and focus stays on the fader (E-07).
Pending (S-28) in the concept, right here: the top-K token on the planner's terminal line scrubs with the value (package 1's core, runnable once the terminal is drawn).

excluded.why: It reads the terminal's words by the concept's paint hook [data-mmcache] (deviation 10: the rebuild's note has no such hook; it says the same words, checked in 33-containers/plans-deck-rows), and its Endings check needs each LED switch to carry its parameter's tip as a title, which the slice's ledButton does not draw.

Its planner-off and lent-file checks are in 33-containers (guard-says-when-it-is-off, drop-zones-take-audio-and-clear); the rest needs the Sampler's scope and the timbre blend (package 3), and the Mastering pedal's offer to add Timbre is found by the concept's [data-additem] hook (deviation 10).
Its guard checks are in 33-containers/guard-says-when-it-is-off; its top-p rail is the XY pad's (the slice's part, which draws no rail yet) and it reads the concept's control catalogue C.

It clicks segments by their label (data-v, deviation 10) and inserts the concept's ctlHTML markup, which the rebuild has no counterpart for. Its terminal chip and flag checks are in 33-containers/terminal-prints-flags-and-gathers-lab-lines; the LCD number's AUTO in 33-containers/tempo-lcd-rows.

Its BPM box now stands in Tempo's LCD row and works, but the scenario writes the box's value straight into the DOM (el.value = 'fast'), which a React controlled input does not see: the box (package 1's NumberBox) keeps the text it had. Its typing checks are in 31-controls and 32-controls-gallery.
It finds Insert example by the concept's [data-example] hook and a segment by its label (deviation 10), and checks the Sampler's scope (package 3).
It calls the concept's sync() and drags the CFG interval handles of the Sampler's scope (package 3).

It chooses a YuE2 solver by its label (data-opt, deviation 10) to bring the plugin's controls; the plugin group (group look plugin) is drawn, and the dice are checked in 33-containers/dice-flow-and-gauge-read-their-values.
It resets a plugin's controls by the concept's [data-plugreset] hook and chooses by label (deviation 10); its flow windows are checked in 33-containers/dice-flow-and-gauge-read-their-values.
Most of its checks are the Sampler's scope and auto Shift knob (package 3) and read the concept's C and optsOf; its speed gauge and terminal line checks hold here (33-containers).
The adapters' cartridges and their side note (package 3); the bank itself is in 33-containers/fader-bank-scale-and-tapes.

Its drop-zone checks are in 33-containers/drop-zones-take-audio-and-clear; it also checks the recent references list (recentRefs, package 3), the toast's Undo after a clear (the toast's package, 6) and the prompt card's latent import (package 4).
It loads a recent reference (recentRefs) and nudges the timbre blend (timbreBlend), both package 3's.
Its selection is the recording span (recordingSpan, package 3).
